verdict.rationale: RingCentral's plan documentation says the service comes with local numbers, so getting a local business number is a documented part of the product. Nothing in the evidence shows a number-search or self-serve purchase flow. missing for 10: documented search of available numbers by area code, a self-serve or API purchase/provisioning flow, evidence that provisioning takes minutes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes

citations.quote: complete with local numbers, extensions, call delegation, call screening, and visual voicemail
